## api-extractor-config-lives-in-package-not-tempdir  (gotcha, verified)
api-extractor's configuration file has to sit inside the package directory it analyses, not a temp directory, because it locates the project's package.json by walking up from the config file's own location rather than taking a project root argument.

- source/cli/internal/tsapisurface/tsapisurface.go

## apidiff-change-carries-no-location  (gotcha, verified)
golang.org/x/exp/apidiff's Change is only {Message string; Compatible bool} — no package path, no token.Pos — so a caller wanting a source line has to parse the `<name>: <what happened>` message text itself and resolve it against a loaded *types.Package; there is no structured, lower-level API.

- source/cli/internal/apisurface/apisurface.go

## bump-era-comes-from-the-previous-tag  (invariant, suspect)
bumpAdmitsBreak decides whether a break is admitted using the previous tag's version era (0.x vs 1.x+), not the target tag's — a release crossing the 1.0.0 boundary (v0.2.0 to v1.0.0) still admits a break even though it is measured on the minor, which goes from 2 to 0.

- source/cli/cmd/lydite/release.go

## cargo-deny-default-config-rejects-every-license  (gotcha, verified)
cargo-deny's default config (no deny.toml present) rejects every license, MIT included, so a crate with no deny.toml fails `check licenses` regardless of how it is actually licensed.

cargo-deny's exit status is a bitmask of which of the run checks failed (licenses vs bans, e.g. 4 vs 2 vs 6), not a plain 0/1 — a verdict check must not narrow to `== 1`.

## cargo-lockfile-cannot-tell-workspace-crate-from-registry  (gotcha, suspect)
